Title: Science & Media Literacy
Description: General education course covering science literacy, media literacy and the intersection of the two.

Title: Mass Media in Society
Description: Analysis of mass media focusing on technological, economic, governmental, and societal impact.

Title: Writing for the Media
Description: Introduction to media writing styles and techniques including writing news stories, audio & video scripts, social media, advertising and public relations content.

Title: Intro to Audio and Video Production
Description: Planning and realization of audio and video productions; studio techniques; audio and video non-linear editing.

Title: Advanced Audio Production
Description: Professional audio production across digital media platforms.

Title: Feature Writing
Description: Learn the essentials of writing and researching feature news pieces.

Title: Copy Editing For News Media
Description: Students build professional news editing skills.

Title: Digital Publishing and Design
Description: Digital publication design and production of layouts.

Title: Advanced News Reporting
Description: Reporting for print and digital media about local and state government.

Title: Fundamentals of Advertising
Description: Provides an overview of advertising from the perspectives of marketing and social roles.

Title: Advertising Copywriting and Design
Description: Create ads for a variety of products using professional design and copywriting techniques.

Title: Essentials of Web Design
Description: An introduction to web design and development for media professionals.

Title: Social Media Content Creation
Description: Examines the role of creators and influencers in the social media landscape. Students learn strategies for building a personal brand, producing engaging content, and growing an audience across platforms. Prerequisite: MC 204 with a C or better.

Title: Advanced Media Writing
Description: Advanced writing techniques for various media platforms.

Title: Media Performance
Description: Extensive instruction and practice in media performance, including on-camera and voice work.

Title: Advanced News Production
Description: Extensive practice in writing, producing, and presenting broadcast news.

Title: Advanced Video Production
Description: Students produce professional-quality video segments.

Title: Commercial Production
Description: Processes and practices in copywriting and production for radio, television, and digital commercials.

Title: Sports Journalism
Description: Course provides overview of sports journalism and enhances students' skills.

Title: Digital Imagery
Description: Capturing, editing, and presenting digital images for media applications.

Title: Women in Mass Communications
Description: Exploration of women's relationship to media.

Title: History of Mass Media
Description: Development of American mass media.

Title: Media Planning
Description: Basic principles of media planning, buying, and strategy for advertising campaigns.

Title: Media Law and Policy
Description: U.S. Constitution and federal and state law related to mass media.

Title: Media Management
Description: Focus on product development and project management in media industries.

Title: Cultural Studies in Media
Description: Use of critical theory to examine media's impact on society and culture.

Title: Advertising Campaigns
Description: Creation and production of advertising campaigns using a mix of media.

Title: Strategic Media Writing
Description: Analyzing and creating strategic communication materials for PR, marketing, and organizational contexts.

Title: Advanced Topics in Writing for Media: Dramatic Writing
Description: Advanced theory and practice of writing for print and visual media.

Title: Advanced Topics in Writing for Media: Other Topics
Description: Advanced theory and practice of writing for print and visual media.

Title: Literary Journalism
Description: Students develop skills in literary non-fiction writing.

Title: Social Media Analytics
Description: Focuses on the use of analytics, including AI-powered tools, to evaluate and improve social media performance. Students collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple platforms using machine learning for pattern recognition and predictive analytics. Part of the AI Social Media Strategist Certificate.

Title: Freelance Media Production
Description: Advanced production techniques for corporate and non-profit videos.

Title: Advanced Video Directing and Producing
Description: Advanced theory and practice in television directing and producing.

Title: Media Post-Production
Description: Theory and practice of post-production including video editing, color correction, and sound design.

Title: Visual Media Analysis
Description: Analysis of still and moving images for artistic and communicative purposes.

Title: Advanced Writing and Designing for Digital Media
Description: Provides a comprehensive overview of both writing and designing for digital media.

Title: Special Studies in Visual Communications
Description: Special independent study in visual communications combining theory and practice.

Title: Narrative Media Production
Description: Write and produce short narrative films and web series.

Title: Photojournalism
Description: Students learn to explore their communities with cameras.

Title: Media Psychology
Description: Media's short term and long term psychological effects on individuals and society.

Title: Research Methods in Mass Media
Description: Examination of traditional and emerging concepts of research in mass communications.

Title: New Media and Technology
Description: Technological changes in the mass media.

Title: Transnational Media
Description: Focus on media ownership, regulation, and cultural impact across national borders.

Title: Documentary Media Production
Description: Evolution of documentary filmmaking; emphasis on student production of original documentary films.

Title: Media Ethics
Description: Critical examination and analysis of values, principles, and ethical decision-making in mass media.

Title: Identity and Emerging Media
Description: Students explore how people construct identities on various emerging media.

Title: Special Topics in Mass Media
Description: Special and advanced topics in the mass media.

Title: Mass Media and Health
Description: Focuses on media literacy in the area of health.

Title: Advanced Mobile Media Design
Description: Designing advanced mobile-based interactive multimedia applications.

Title: International Advertising
Description: Issues that affect advertising and communications in a global marketplace.

Title: Internship/Senior Portfolio
Description: Experience with professional media under joint supervision. Includes senior portfolio requirement.

Title: Internship
Description: Experience with professional media under joint supervision.

Title: Advanced Practices
Description: Independent study in areas where student has completed all formal course work.

Title: Readings in Mass Media
Description: Selected readings in depth with member of faculty.

Title: Independent Study
Description: Special projects, research, and independent study.
